ud5.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud5.10:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Cūlapanthako bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
ud5.10:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Cūlapanthakaṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
ud5.10:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
ud5.10:5.4: saddāyamānā (?) Panthakena cā ti' Soṇassa therassa vaggo pañcamo.
